"""Public default chunk and decode-active slice validation, not timing evidence."""
import concurrent.futures, hashlib, json, os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import httpx
from scripts.qwen4exp_canonical_ar_bench import _wait_for_health, _terminate
from scripts.qwen4exp_http_mtp_economics import _one, route_matches_request
BASE=Path('/tmp/qwen38fn-prefill-20261022');ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=BASE/'chunk-live-slices.json'
command=json.loads(Path('/tmp/qwen38fn-gufo-20261021/served-request-phases.json').read_text())['command']
for flag,value in [('--max-context-tokens','8192'),('--max-active-requests','2'),('--prefix-cache','off'),('--served-model-name','perf'),('--port','18083')]:command[command.index(flag)+1]=value
fixture=json.loads(Path('benchmarks/fixtures/qwen4exp_canonical_ar_p512_p1024_p4096.json').read_text())['cases']
case=next(c for c in fixture if c['prompt_tokens']==4096 and c['category']=='code')
env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=str(ROOT));env.pop('HIPENGINE_MAX_PREFILL_CHUNK_TOKENS',None)
report={'status':'running','command':command,'source_diff':subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','HEAD','--','hipengine']).decode(),'cases':[]}
def save():OUT.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
def slices(client,result,known_ids=()):
 telemetry=client.get('http://127.0.0.1:18083/v1/hipengine/decode');telemetry.raise_for_status();data=telemetry.json()
 request_id=result['decode_state'].get('request_id')
 request_id=None if request_id is None else int(request_id)
 found=[]
 def walk(obj):
  if isinstance(obj,dict):
   for key,value in obj.items():
    if key=='recent_prefill_slices':
     found.extend(s for s in value if (request_id in s['request_ids'] if request_id is not None else any(x not in known_ids for x in s['request_ids'])))
    else:walk(value)
 walk(data)
 assert found,('missing_live_slices',request_id,data)
 return found
def known(client):
 data=client.get('http://127.0.0.1:18083/v1/hipengine/decode').json()
 return {x for s in data['decode']['recent_prefill_slices'] for x in s['request_ids']}
with OUT.with_suffix('.server.log').open('wb') as log:
 process=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=ROOT,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 try:
  _wait_for_health('127.0.0.1',18083,600,process=process)
  with httpx.Client(timeout=600) as client,concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as executor:
   for mtp in (False,True):
    for length in (1537,4096):
     row=dict(case,prompt_token_ids=case['prompt_token_ids'][:length],prompt_tokens=length)
     previous=known(client)
     result=_one(client,'http://127.0.0.1:18083','perf',row,mtp,16)
     assert route_matches_request(result)
     selected=slices(client,result,previous)
     assert sum(s['tokens'] for s in selected)==length and max(s['tokens'] for s in selected)==length
     assert all(s['decode_rows']==0 and s['committed_tokens']==s['tokens'] for s in selected)
     report['cases'].append({'mode':'idle','mtp':mtp,'length':length,'result':result,'slices':selected});save()
    peer={'model':'perf','prompt':case['prompt_token_ids'][:17],'temperature':0,'max_tokens':256,'ignore_eos':True,'speculative_mtp':False,'stream':True}
    future=None
    with client.stream('POST','http://127.0.0.1:18083/v1/completions',json=peer) as response:
     response.raise_for_status()
     for line in response.iter_lines():
      if not line.startswith('data: ') or line=='data: [DONE]':continue
      event=json.loads(line[6:]); choices=event.get('choices',[])
      if future is None and any(c.get('text') for c in choices):
       previous=known(client)
       future=executor.submit(_one,client,'http://127.0.0.1:18083','perf',case,mtp,16)
    assert future is not None
    result=future.result(timeout=600);assert route_matches_request(result)
    selected=slices(client,result,previous)
    assert any(s['decode_rows']>0 for s in selected),selected
    assert all(s['tokens']<=1024 for s in selected if s['decode_rows']>0),selected
    report['cases'].append({'mode':'decode_active','mtp':mtp,'result':result,'slices':selected});save()
    committed=[s for s in selected if s['committed_tokens']]
    assert sum(s['committed_tokens'] for s in selected)==4096, selected
    position=0
    for s in committed:
     assert s['context_lengths']==[position], selected
     position+=s['committed_tokens']
  report['status']='passed'
 except BaseException as exc:
  report['status']='failed';report['error']=repr(exc);raise
 finally:
  _terminate(process);save()
